```{r Load clean_names_lowercase function}
clean_names_lowercase <- function(x) {

  x <- iconv(x, from = "", to = "UTF-8", sub = "")
  x <- stringi::stri_trans_general(x, "Latin-ASCII")

  x %>%
    tolower() %>%
    trimws()
}
```

```{r Major_Functional_Group patch for CONAPESCA_GOC_MarineLandings}
# Fill in missing values based on MajorFunctionalGroup_Key:
CONAPESCA_GOC_MarineLandings <- CONAPESCA_GOC_MarineLandings0 %>%
  left_join(
    MajorFunctionalGroup_Key %>%
      select(estimated_genus_name, Major_Functional_Group),
    by = "estimated_genus_name",
    suffix = c("", ".lookup")
  )

CONAPESCA_GOC_MarineLandings <- CONAPESCA_GOC_MarineLandings %>%
  mutate(
    Major_Functional_Group = coalesce(
      Major_Functional_Group,
      Major_Functional_Group.lookup
    )
  ) %>%
  select(-Major_Functional_Group.lookup)

# 3246583 obs., 58 var.

# SANITY CHECK:
sum(is.na(CONAPESCA_GOC_MarineLandings$Major_Functional_Group))
# Only 26 records unassigned. Looks good!

```

```{r Patch the new shark assignments}
colnames(GenusFamilyGroup_Key0)
unique(GenusFamilyGroup_Key0$Major_Functional_Group)

Shark_Key<- GenusFamilyGroup_Key0 %>%
  filter(Major_Functional_Group== "Sharks") %>%
  select(estimated_genus_name, Major_Functional_Group_adjusted) %>%
  distinct()
# 20 obs., 2 vars.

# Patch in the sharks:
CONAPESCA_GOC_MarineLandings <- CONAPESCA_GOC_MarineLandings %>%
  left_join(
    Shark_Key %>%
      select(estimated_genus_name, Major_Functional_Group_adjusted),
    by = "estimated_genus_name"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Major_Functional_Group = coalesce(
      Major_Functional_Group_adjusted,
      Major_Functional_Group
    )
  ) %>%
  select(-Major_Functional_Group_adjusted)

sum(is.na(CONAPESCA_GOC_MarineLandings$Major_Functional_Group))
# Only 26 records unassigned. Looks good!

table(CONAPESCA_GOC_MarineLandings$Major_Functional_Group)

Shark_Landings<- CONAPESCA_GOC_MarineLandings %>%
  filter(recorded_taxa_group %in% c("TIBURON", "CAZON"),
         Major_Functional_Group %in% c("Large sharks", "Medium-Large sharks", "Small sharks", "Sharks"))
# 167855 obs., 58 vars. (5 shark values unassigned)

unique(Shark_Landings$estimated_genus_name[which(Shark_Landings$recorded_taxa_group=="CAZON")])
unique(Shark_Landings$estimated_genus_name[which(Shark_Landings$recorded_taxa_group=="TIBURON")])
# NOTE TO SELF: shark genera within "CAZON" or "TIBURON" can be small, medium, or large, there is no general rule.

# Patch all sharks in CONAPESCA_GOC_MarineLandings:
CONAPESCA_GOC_MarineLandings <- CONAPESCA_GOC_MarineLandings %>%
  mutate(
    
    # First patch examples of NA:
    Major_Functional_Group = case_when(
      recorded_taxa_group %in% c("TIBURON", "CAZON") &
        is.na(Major_Functional_Group) ~ "Sharks",
      
      TRUE ~ Major_Functional_Group
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # Then change assignment on "Sharks"
    Major_Functional_Group = case_when(
      Major_Functional_Group == "Sharks" ~ "Sharks (size unknown)",
      
      TRUE ~ Major_Functional_Group
    )
  )

# 3246583 obs., 58 var. Same as before. Good!
```

# DECISION POINT: Select HISTORIC and CONTEMPORARY periods:
```{r Select historic and contemporary start and end}
OCEA_HISTORIC_START = 2004
OCEA_HISTORIC_END = 2014
OCEA_CONTEMPORARY_START = 2015
OCEA_CONTEMPORARY_END = 2024
```

```{r Extract the top open ocean taxa per group in the CONAPESCA data}
colnames(OpenOcean_Landings0)

OCEA_GOC.Landings_TopSpecies0<- OpenOcean_Landings0 %>%
  filter(year >= OCEA_HISTORIC_START, year <= OCEA_CONTEMPORARY_END) %>%  # Filter from study period, 2004-2014
  group_by(year, Major_Functional_Group, estimated_genus_name, estimated_species_name) %>%
  summarize(
    total_landings_mt = sum(weight_kg_corrected, na.rm = TRUE)/1000,
    .groups = "drop"
  )
# 1383 obs., 5 vars.

OCEA_GOC.Landings_TopSpecies <- OCEA_GOC.Landings_TopSpecies0 %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(estimated_species_name),
    !estimated_species_name %in% c("nei", "unknown", NA)
  ) %>%
  group_by(Major_Functional_Group, estimated_species_name) %>%
  summarise(
    total_landings = sum(total_landings_mt, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(Major_Functional_Group) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = total_landings, n = 5, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()
# 30 obs., 3 vars.

```


# STEP 3: Calculate mean condition values for OCEA genera across the entire GOC:

```{r Summarize OCE gulfwide landings in OCEA_GOC.Landings_summary}
colnames(OpenOcean_Landings0)

OCEA_Landings_summary <- OpenOcean_Landings0 %>%
  mutate(
    estimated_genus_name = if_else(
      is.na(estimated_genus_name),
      "nei",
      estimated_genus_name
    ),
    Major_Functional_Group = clean_names_lowercase(Major_Functional_Group)
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    year,
    Major_Functional_Group,
    estimated_genus_name
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    total_landings_mt = sum(weight_kg_corrected, na.rm = TRUE) / 1000,
    species_names = paste(
      sort(unique(na.omit(estimated_species_name))),
      collapse = "; "
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
# 1168 obs., 5 vars.

OCEA_Group_totals <- OCEA_Landings_summary %>%
  filter(year >= OCEA_HISTORIC_START, year <= OCEA_CONTEMPORARY_END) %>%
  group_by(year, Major_Functional_Group) %>%
  summarise(
    total_landings_mt = sum(total_landings_mt, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
# 147 obs., 3 vars.

```

## PLOT open-ocean landings over time (gulfwide)

```{r Plot open-ocean landings over time (gulfwide)}
colnames(OCEA_Landings_summary)

# Plot 1, panel per region:

OCEA_Group_Landings_plot <- OCEA_Landings_summary %>%
  filter(year >= OCEA_HISTORIC_START, year <= OCEA_CONTEMPORARY_END) %>%
  
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = year,
      y = total_landings_mt
    )
  ) +
  
  # Individual genus trajectories
  geom_line(
    aes(
      group = estimated_genus_name,
      text = paste0(
        "Genus: ", estimated_genus_name,
        "<br>Year: ", year,
        "<br>Landings: ", round(total_landings_mt, 2), " mt"
      )
    ),
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.5,
    alpha = 0.5
  ) +
  
  # Functional-group total
  geom_line(
    data = OCEA_Group_totals,
    aes(
      x = year,
      y = total_landings_mt,
      group = Major_Functional_Group,
      text = paste0(
        "Functional group: ", Major_Functional_Group,
        "<br>Year: ", year,
        "<br>Total landings: ", round(total_landings_mt, 2), " mt"
      )
    ),
    color = "#2C7FB8",
    linewidth = 1.0
  ) +
  
  geom_point(
    data = OCEA_Group_totals,
    aes(
      x = year,
      y = total_landings_mt,
      text = paste0(
        "Functional group: ", Major_Functional_Group,
        "<br>Year: ", year,
        "<br>Total landings: ", round(total_landings_mt, 2), " mt"
      )
    ),
    shape = 16,
    size = 2,
    color = "#2C7FB8"
  ) +
  
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 2018,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "grey50",
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  
  facet_wrap(
    ~ Major_Functional_Group,
    scales = "free_y"
  ) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Open-Ocean Landings by Functional Group",
    subtitle = "Gulf-wide annual landings, 2004–2024",
    y = "Total landings (metric tonnes)",
    x = "Year"
  ) +
  
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(
      size = 14,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    plot.title = element_text(
      size = 16,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      size = 12
    )
  )
```

# Reference Points: calculate OCEA reference points based on genus-level detail:

```{r Calculate OCEA_taxa_reference_points}
colnames(OCEA_Landings_summary)

# Calculate pre- and post-2014 means gulf-wide:

OCEA_genus_ref_points <- OCEA_Landings_summary %>%
  filter(year >= OCEA_HISTORIC_START, year <= OCEA_HISTORIC_END) %>%
  
  group_by(estimated_genus_name) %>%
  
  summarise(
    Major_Functional_Group = first(na.omit(Major_Functional_Group)),
    mean_HISTORIC_catch_mt = mean(total_landings_mt, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_years = n_distinct(year),
    
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 62 obs., 4 vars.
```

```{r Calculate condition for all genera relative to ref. point}
colnames(OCEA_GOC_Landings_summary)
colnames(OCEA_genus_ref_points)

CONAPESCA_OCEA_genus.landings.data0 <- OCEA_GOC_Landings_summary %>%
  left_join(
    OCEA_genus_ref_points,
    by= c("Major_Functional_Group", "estimated_genus_name")
  )
# 1168 obs., 6 vars.

CONAPESCA_OCEA_genus.landings.data<- CONAPESCA_OCEA_genus.landings.data0 %>%
  filter(year >= OCEA_HISTORIC_START, year <= OCEA_CONTEMPORARY_END) %>%
  mutate(
    ratio_catch_v_ref = (total_landings_mt / mean_HISTORIC_catch_mt),
    taxa_condition = pmin(ratio_catch_v_ref * 100, 100)
    )
# 983 obs., 8 vars.

```

```{r Aggregate at the group level}
colnames(CONAPESCA_OCEA_genus.landings.data)

# Aggregate at the group level:
CONAPESCA_OCEA_group.landings.data <- CONAPESCA_OCEA_genus.landings.data %>%
  select(year, Major_Functional_Group, estimated_genus_name, taxa_condition, total_landings_mt) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  
  group_by(year, Major_Functional_Group) %>%
  
  summarise(
    group_condition = mean(taxa_condition, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n_distinct(estimated_genus_name),
    total_landings_mt = sum(total_landings_mt, na.rm= TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

dim(CONAPESCA_OCEA_group.landings.data)
# 147 obs., 5 vars.

```


```{r Calculate group means pre- post- 2014 PURG?}
colnames(CONAPESCA_OCEA_group.landings.data)

OCEA_group_condition_means <- CONAPESCA_OCEA_group.landings.data %>%
  group_by(Major_Functional_Group) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_mt_HISTORIC = mean(
      total_landings_mt[year >= OCEA_HISTORIC_START & year <= OCEA_HISTORIC_END],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    mean_mt_CONTEMPORARY = mean(
      total_landings_mt[year >= OCEA_CONTEMPORARY_START & year <= OCEA_CONTEMPORARY_END],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 7 obs., 3 vars.
```

```{r Plot OCE GROUP means over time}
# Plot OCE GROUP means over time:
OCEA_Group_Landings_pre.post_plot <- CONAPESCA_OCEA_group.landings.data %>%

  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = year,
      y = total_landings_mt,
      group = Major_Functional_Group
    )
  ) +

  # Annual functional-group trajectory
  geom_line(
    color = "darkgrey",
    linewidth = 1.0
  ) +

  # Annual points
  geom_point(
    shape = 16,
    size = 2,
    color = "darkgrey"
  ) +

  # Pre-mean: 2004–2014 only
  geom_segment(
    data = OCEA_group_condition_means,
    aes(
      x = OCEA_HISTORIC_START,
      xend = OCEA_HISTORIC_END,
      y = mean_mt_HISTORIC,
      yend = mean_mt_HISTORIC
    ),
    color = "blue",
    linetype = "solid",
    linewidth = 0.9
  ) +

  # Post-2014 mean: 2015–2024 only
  geom_segment(
    data = OCEA_group_condition_means,
    aes(
      x = OCEA_CONTEMPORARY_START,
      xend = OCEA_CONTEMPORARY_END,
      y = mean_mt_CONTEMPORARY,
      yend = mean_mt_CONTEMPORARY
    ),
    color = "#D95F02",
    linetype = "solid",
    linewidth = 0.9
  ) +

  # Reference-period cutoff
  geom_vline(
```

# NEW (Oct 14 2026)
Going to calculate condition at the genus level as oppossed to group level so I can compare fisheries-dependent versus independent across specific taxa.

```{r Calculate group means pre- post- 2014}
colnames(CONAPESCA_OCEA_genus.landings.data)

OCEA_FD_genus_condition0 <- CONAPESCA_OCEA_genus.landings.data %>%
  group_by(Major_Functional_Group, estimated_genus_name) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_mt_HISTORIC = mean(
      total_landings_mt[
        year >= OCEA_HISTORIC_START &
          year <= OCEA_HISTORIC_END
      ],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    mean_mt_CONTEMPORARY = mean(
      total_landings_mt[
        year >= OCEA_CONTEMPORARY_START &
          year <= OCEA_CONTEMPORARY_END
      ],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    # Historic period
    years_HISTORIC = {
      valid_years <- year[
        between(year, OCEA_HISTORIC_START, OCEA_HISTORIC_END) &
          !is.na(total_landings_mt)
      ]

      if (length(valid_years)) {
        paste0(min(valid_years), "-", max(valid_years))
      } else {
        NA_character_
      }
    },

    year_midpoint_HISTORIC = {
      valid_years <- year[
        between(year, OCEA_HISTORIC_START, OCEA_HISTORIC_END) &
          !is.na(total_landings_mt)
      ]

      if (length(valid_years)) {
        mean(range(valid_years))
      } else {
        NA_real_
      }
    },

    # Contemporary period
    years_CONTEMPORARY = {
      valid_years <- year[
        between(year, OCEA_CONTEMPORARY_START, OCEA_CONTEMPORARY_END) &
          !is.na(total_landings_mt)
      ]

      if (length(valid_years)) {
        paste0(min(valid_years), "-", max(valid_years))
      } else {
        NA_character_
      }
    },

    year_midpoint_CONTEMPORARY = {
      valid_years <- year[
        between(year, OCEA_CONTEMPORARY_START, OCEA_CONTEMPORARY_END) &
          !is.na(total_landings_mt)
      ]

      if (length(valid_years)) {
        mean(range(valid_years))
      } else {
        NA_real_
      }
    },

    n_pre_2014 = sum(
      year < 2014 & !is.na(total_landings_mt),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    n_post_2014 = sum(
      year >= 2014 & !is.na(total_landings_mt),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 68 obs., 8 vars.
```

# Calculate OCEA_group_FD_condition (fisheries dependent; gulf-wide per group, not time varying):

```{r Filter out genera with fewer than 5 data points in either period}
colnames(OCEA_FD_genus_condition0)

OCEA_FD_genus_condition0

OCEA_FD_genus_condition<- OCEA_FD_genus_condition0 %>%
  filter(n_pre_2014 >= 5 & n_post_2014 >= 5) %>%
  mutate(
    ratio_contemp_v_hist = mean_mt_CONTEMPORARY / mean_mt_HISTORIC,
    condition_FD = pmin((mean_mt_CONTEMPORARY / mean_mt_HISTORIC) * 100, 100)
  )
# 41 obs., 12 vars.

# Extract genera names of interest
OCEA_genera_of_interest<- unique(OCEA_FD_genus_condition$estimated_genus_name)

```

```{r CLOSER LOOK: should there be a landings min? answer is no.}
ggplot(OCEA_FD_genus_condition, aes(x = mean_mt_HISTORIC)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 40, fill = "steelblue", color = "white") +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Historic Genus-Level Landings",
    x = "Mean historic landings (metric tons)",
    y = "Number of genera"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()


ggplot(
  OCEA_FD_genus_condition,

) +

    bins = 40,

  ) +
  scale_x_log10() +

    x = "Mean historic landings (metric tons, log scale)",

  ) +

quantile(
  OCEA_FD_genus_condition$mean_mt_HISTORIC,
  probs = seq(0, 1, 0.05),
  na.rm = TRUE
)

 #           0%            5%           10%           15%           20%           25%           30%           35%           40% 
 #     0.399000      1.758243      2.812280      4.486773      6.321800      9.968929     68.579794     74.298932     85.809527 
 #          45%           50%           55%           60%           65%           70%           75%           80%           85% 
 #   169.134327    381.036900    600.433429    690.469556   1199.839464   3098.601482   5892.379658  11569.403655  22784.032795 
 #          90%           95%          100% 
 # 41445.879862  90346.211773 219910.042785 

# Does size of historic catch (relative to other size bins) impact condition?

ggplot(
  OCEA_FD_genus_condition,
  aes(x = log(mean_mt_HISTORIC), y = ratio_contemp_v_hist)
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 2, color = "steelblue") +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 10,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "red",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Historic Mean Landings vs. Condition",
    subtitle = "Dashed red line = proposed 10 mt minimum",
    x = "Mean historic landings (mt)",
    y = "Condition"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

test_lm<- lm(ratio_contemp_v_hist ~ log(mean_mt_HISTORIC), 
             data= OCEA_FD_genus_condition)

summary(test_lm)
# p-value: 0.006913; The negative association supports the idea that low-landings genera tend to receive higher condition scores...

# What if I implement a 10mt historic cut-off? Seems like the genera with less than 10mt mean historic catch might be receiving a condition score that is artificially high. Perhaps they were not actually targeted as a fishery in any meaningful way prior to 2014...

t.test(
  ratio_contemp_v_hist ~ (mean_mt_HISTORIC < 10),
  data = OCEA_FD_genus_condition
)
# mean in group FALSE = 3.023302; mean in group TRUE = 14.763369; p-value = 0.1158, not sig.

t.test(
  ratio_contemp_v_hist ~ (mean_mt_HISTORIC < 5),
  data = OCEA_FD_genus_condition
)
# mean in group FALSE = 4.953314; mean in group TRUE = 12.097634; p-value = 0.277, not sig.

# DECISION POINT: No, don't implement a cut off. Not a lot of compelling evidence that these scores are unreliable.
```

```{r Clean and filter down fishery-independent datasets to prepare for merge}
# Filter records that came before the 2014 cut off

# IUCN Red List:
colnames(IUCN_OCEA_taxa.data0)

  filter(assessment_year >= 2014) %>%
  select(data_source, taxonomic_group, specific_taxa, 
         IUCN_condition = condition, 
         IUCN_trend = trend, 
         IUCN_assessment_year= assessment_year)

IUCN_OCEA_taxa.data <- IUCN_OCEA_taxa.data %>%
   mutate(estimated_genus_name = str_extract(
      trimws(as.character(specific_taxa)),
```

```{r Merge}
OCEA_FI_genus_condition0 <- IUCN_OCEA_genus.data %>%
```

# STEP 3: CALCULATE OPEN OCEAN "CURRENT STATUS", i.e. gulfwide condition post versus pre 2014 (source: CONAPESCA, 2025; IUCN, 2025; Lit Review, 2025)  ------------------------------

```{r Merge OCEA_FD_genus_condition and OCEA_FI_genus_condition for OCEA_Scores_by.genus}
colnames(OCEA_FD_genus_condition)
colnames(OCEA_FI_genus_condition)

OCEA_Scores_by.genus <- OCEA_FD_genus_condition %>%
  rename(taxonomic_group = Major_Functional_Group) %>%
  full_join(
    OCEA_FI_genus_condition,
    by = c("taxonomic_group", "estimated_genus_name")
  )

# 63 obs., 23 vars.

```

```{r Calculate final OCEA_Scores_by.group per group and gulf-wide}
colnames(OCEA_Scores_by.genus)

OCEA_Scores_by.genus <- OCEA_Scores_by.genus %>%
  mutate(
    OCEA_current_status = round(
      rowMeans(cbind(condition_FD, avg_IUCN_condition, avg_Lit.Review_condition), na.rm = TRUE),
      1
    )
  )
# 63 obs., 24 vars.

colnames(OCEA_Scores_by.genus)

OCEA_Scores_by.group <- OCEA_Scores_by.genus %>%
  select(
    taxonomic_group,
    condition_FD,
    avg_IUCN_condition,
    avg_Lit.Review_condition,
    OCEA_current_status
  ) %>%
  group_by(taxonomic_group) %>%
  summarise(
    n_genera = n(),

    OCEA_current_status = if (all(is.na(OCEA_current_status))) {
      NA_real_
    } else {
      mean(OCEA_current_status, na.rm = TRUE)
    },

    CONAPESCA_data = any(!is.na(condition_FD)),
    CONAPESCA_condition = if (all(is.na(condition_FD))) {
      NA_real_
    } else {
      mean(condition_FD, na.rm = TRUE)
    },

    IUCN_data = any(!is.na(avg_IUCN_condition)),
    IUCN_condition = if (all(is.na(avg_IUCN_condition))) {
      NA_real_
    } else {
      mean(avg_IUCN_condition, na.rm = TRUE)
    },

    Lit.Review_data = any(!is.na(avg_Lit.Review_condition)),
    Lit_Review_condition = if (all(is.na(avg_Lit.Review_condition))) {
      NA_real_
    } else {
      mean(avg_Lit.Review_condition, na.rm = TRUE)
    },

    .groups = "drop"
  )
  
# 12 obs., 9 vars.

mean(OCEA_Scores_by.group$OCEA_current_status, na.rm = TRUE)
# 72

```

```{r Calculate OCEA_Trend using METHOD A}
colnames(OCEA_Scores)

# MODIFIED METHOD A: 
# See GitHub issue, Oct 7 2026, for more details: https://github.com/OHI-GOC/OHI_GOC_issues/issues/127#issuecomment-6041025924
# slope <- (condition_end - condition_start) / n_years
# trend_pct_yr <- (slope / condition_start) * 100

OCEA_HISTORIC_MIDPOINT <- round(mean(c(OCEA_HISTORIC_START, OCEA_HISTORIC_END)), 1)
OCEA_CONTEMPORARY_MIDPOINT <- round(mean(c(OCEA_CONTEMPORARY_START, OCEA_CONTEMPORARY_END)), 1)

# Calculate the trend as the linear annualized percent change between the most recent year (i.e., 2021) and 5-10 years prior (i.e., 2013)
OCEA_Trend <- OCEA_Scores %>%

  group_by(rgn_name, rgn_id) %>%
  
  mutate(
    n_years = OCEA_CONTEMPORARY_END - OCEA_HISTORIC_END,
    OCEA_ref_status = 100,
    slope = (OCEA_current_status - OCEA_ref_status) / n_years,
    trend = round((slope / OCEA_ref_status) * 100, 2)
  )

OCEA_Trend

```

```{r Save OCEA_Trend}
          row.names = FALSE)
```

Search the GOC landings for any billfish

```{r Filter for billfish}
colnames(CONAPESCA_GOC_MarFisheryLandings)
unique(CONAPESCA_GOC_MarFisheryLandings$Major_Functional_Group)

fishes<- c("Large pelagic bony fish", "Small pelagic bony fish", 
           "Demersal marine fishes",
           "Diadromous fishes",
           "Marine fishes NEI", "Marine or freshwater fishes NEI")

billfish_genera<- c("Istiophorus",
               "Xiphias",
               "Makaira",
               "Tetrapturus",
               "Istiompax",
               "Tetrapturus",
               "Kajikia")

billfish_families<- c("Istiophoridae",
                      "Xiphiidae")

CONAPESCA_GOC_BillfishLandings<- CONAPESCA_GOC_MarFisheryLandings %>%
  filter(estimated_genus_name %in% billfish_genera | estimated_family_name %in% billfish_families) %>%
  select(state, OHI_region_est, OHI_region_name,
         year, month,
         Major_Functional_Group,
         recorded_taxa_group, recorded_taxa_name, recorded_taxa_name_clean, estimated_taxa_group,
         recorded_scientific_name, estimated_species_name,
         estimated_genus_name, estimated_family_name, most_likely_family,
         landed_weight, live_weight, weight_kg_corrected,
         sector_estimate_draft)
# 8780 obs., 19 vars.

table(CONAPESCA_GOC_BillfishLandings$estimated_family_name)
table(CONAPESCA_GOC_BillfishLandings$most_likely_family)
table(CONAPESCA_GOC_BillfishLandings$recorded_taxa_name_clean)

CONAPESCA_GOC_Billfish_summary <- CONAPESCA_GOC_BillfishLandings %>%
  filter(year >= 2018, year <= 2024) %>%
  group_by(most_likely_family, estimated_genus_name, estimated_species_name, year) %>%
  summarize(
    GOC_annual_landings = sum(weight_kg_corrected, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  mutate(
    percent_annual_landings = round(
      100 * GOC_annual_landings / sum(GOC_annual_landings, na.rm = TRUE),
      0
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
# 30 obs., 6 vars.

```
